name: pi-radar
description: Radar daemon client, communication, publication, execution, location, launch and inspection surface for Pi extensions.

scripts.build: esbuild index.ts extension/generated-contracts.ts extension/radar-children.ts extension/radar-client.ts extension/radar-communication.ts extension/radar-execution.ts extension/radar-inspection.ts extension/radar-launch.ts extension/radar-location.ts extension/radar-publication.ts extension/radar-runtime.ts extension/baseline.ts --outbase=. --outdir=dist --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22
scripts.typecheck:contracts: tsc --noEmit --strict --skipLibCheck --target ES2022 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --allowImportingTsExtensions --types node index.ts extension/baseline.ts extension/generated-contracts.ts extension/generated-contracts.typecheck.ts extension/radar-children.ts extension/radar-client.ts extension/radar-communication.ts extension/radar-execution.ts extension/radar-launch.test.ts extension/radar-publication.ts extension/radar-runtime.ts extension/radar-runtime.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run check:contracts && npm run typecheck:contracts && node --experimental-strip-types --test extension/*.test.ts
